title: Outside ChristmasCrowd December 5 2025 by kvgarlic

sourceDescription: Recorded in a small town in southern Illinois on Friday December 5 2025. The soundscape is a gathering of people excited to attend the official Lighting of the Christmas Tree. A variety of voices are heard, and the overall feeling is happiness and anticipation.
